text: Ok, how about for 3d zig file, or any of the 3d for that matter, can you find anything that is duplicate more than once, and can be a helper rather than a full rewrite of the same logic
resolution: Completed a read-only duplicate-logic audit of framework/gpu/3d.zig and its adjacent 3D/editor GPU modules. Identified and ranked concrete helper extractions (texture binding creation, formula pipeline construction, region slot/data install, instance packing, topology metadata install, retopo plan install, overlay projection/hit tests, retained pools) plus cross-file duplicates in mesh_edit, model_paint, indexed_edit_mesh, paint_program, and panel/world window blitters. No source files changed; no tests needed for the audit.
